value: The shop-msg OUTBOX is keyed by (work_id, message_type), so multiple message types CAN coexist under one work_id — e.g. a work_done AND a mechanism_observation on the same lead work_id live as separate rows. BUT 'shop-msg read outbox --work-id <id>' surfaces only the SINGLE most-recent row (no message-type selector), so after you emit a mechanism_observation on a work_id that already has a work_done, read-outbox shows ONLY the observation and a naive grep reports '0 work_done' — a DISPLAY limitation, NOT data loss. To see all rows use 'shop-msg dump --direction outbox'. The CLI has an idempotency guard: 'respond work_done' refuses to overwrite an existing work_done ('use --force to replace') — do NOT --force to 'restore' a work_done that read-outbox seems to be missing; --force would REPLACE the genuine original with a reconstructed copy. Always premise-check with 'dump' before any --force. (Filed mechanism_observation jje + this memory after a near-miss this session.) Practical guidance: when emitting a mechanism_observation, keying it to the lead work_id is fine (coexists with work_done), but using a distinct BC-side --work-id + --observed-during <lead-id> avoids the read-outbox display confusion entirely.
